description: Experience the vibrant flavors of the Middle East with this classic Falafel Wrap. Crispy, spiced falafel patties are nestled in warm pita bread with fresh vegetables and drizzled generously with creamy tahini sauce, creating a perfectly balanced and satisfying meal. It is a wholesome, flavorful, and easy-to-make lunch option that brings authentic taste right to your table.

instructions.title: Prepare the Falafel Mixture
instructions.text: In a food processor, combine drained chickpeas, chopped onion, garlic cloves, fresh parsley, and fresh cilantro. Pulse until coarsely chopped, but not pureed. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl. Stir in the flour, baking powder, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix thoroughly until well combined. If the mixture is too wet to form patties, add a little more flour, one tablespoon at a time.

instructions.title: Form and Fry the Falafel
instructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot or fryer to 350-375°F (175-190°C). Using a falafel scoop or your hands, form the mixture into small patties or balls, about 1.5 inches in diameter. Carefully drop a few falafel into the hot oil, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot. Fry for 3-5 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil. Repeat with the remaining mixture.

instructions.title: Make the Tahini Sauce
instructions.text: In a small bowl, whisk together tahini, fresh lemon juice, minced garlic, and salt. Gradually add cold water, starting with 1/4 cup, whisking continuously until the sauce reaches a smooth, creamy, and pourable consistency. You may need more or less water depending on your desired thickness. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

instructions.title: Prepare the Vegetables
instructions.text: While the falafel are frying, prepare your fresh vegetables. Shred the romaine lettuce, dice the tomatoes, dice the cucumbers, and chop the pickled turnips or pickles. Arrange them in separate bowls for easy assembly.

instructions.title: Warm the Pita Bread
instructions.text: Gently warm the pita bread. You can do this in a dry skillet over medium heat for about 30 seconds per side, in a microwave for 15-20 seconds, or in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 1-2 minutes until soft and pliable.

instructions.title: Assemble the Falafel Wraps
instructions.text: Lay a warm pita bread flat. Spread a generous amount of tahini sauce inside. Layer with shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, diced cucumbers, and chopped pickles. Place 3-4 hot falafel patties or balls on top of the vegetables. Drizzle with more tahini sauce if desired. Fold or roll the pita bread tightly to create a wrap. Serve immediately and enjoy the authentic taste of the Middle East!

tips: For extra crispy falafel, ensure your oil is at the correct temperature (350-375°F) and do not overcrowd the frying pot, as this lowers the oil temperature.
Adjust the consistency of your tahini sauce by gradually adding cold water. For a thicker sauce, use less water; for a thinner, drizzly sauce, add a bit more until it reaches your preference.
To prevent your wraps from becoming soggy, assemble them just before serving. You can prepare all components ahead of time and store them separately in the refrigerator.
